esp32.detail: 3 pins wired; XKC-Y25-NPN non-contact liquid level sensor needs at least 5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.OUT → D25 (GPIO25). Added a 10 kΩ resistor from OUT to 3V3, as the datasheet's circuit requires. Added the xkc_y25.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports liquid when the sensor is triggered: passes

Reports liquid when the sensor is triggered: passes
